The '''Invisible Hand cantina''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in [[Gnawer's Roost]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] that was named after the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']].

==History==
It was decorated with old [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] recruitment posters, war memorabilia, and pieces of alloy that were supposedly parts of the [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']] that fell on the ground during its destruction in the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]]. The [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Klef]] worked there as a [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] and the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Tekkur]] was a [[Bouncer (occupation)/Legends|bouncer]].

The [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]], [[Tavik Moern]] once lured an [[Alderaanian Resistance]] team there and, along with four [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] thugs, attacked them.
